Predicates:
RomanceLanguage(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
IndoEuropeanLanguage(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
LanguageFamily(f) ::: f is a language family.
WithinFamily(x, f) ::: x is within language family f.
French(x) ::: x is French.
Spanish(x) ::: x is Spanish.
German(x) ::: x is German.
Related(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
Basque(x) ::: x is Basque.
NotRelated(x, y) ::: x is not related to y.

Premises:
∀x (RomanceLanguage(x) → IndoEuropeanLanguage(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
RomanceLanguage(f) ::: The Romance languages are a language family.
∀x ∀f (WithinFamily(x, f) → RomanceLanguage(x)) ::: All languages within a language family are Romance languages.
French(f) ::: French is a Romance language.
Spanish(s) ::: Spanish is a Romance language.
German(g) ::: German is a language.
Related(s, g) ::: Spanish is related to German.
NotRelated(b, y) ::: Basque is not related to any other language.

Conclusion:
¬RomanceLanguage(g) ::: German is not a Romance language.
